offerings.name: Search (/search)
offerings.pricing: $7 / 1k requests（基础价含最多 10 个结果）；超过 10 个结果每个 $1 / 1k results；AI page summaries $1 / 1k pages
offerings.price_basis: PAYG 基础档（最多 10 结果）
offerings.free_quota: New accounts get $20 in free credits (around 2,800 searches) and the Free Tier adds $10 in credits every month.
offerings.note: 含 Highlights、structured outputs、AI summary 输出形式；auto 为自适应默认搜索类型。

offerings.name: Deep Search
offerings.pricing: deep-lite $12 / 1k requests; deep $12 / 1k requests; deep-reasoning $15 / 1k requests
offerings.price_basis: Deep Search（type=deep-lite / deep，最多 10 结果）
offerings.output_type: Multi-step research with structured outputs and citations
offerings.note: 延迟：deep-lite ~4s；deep 4–15s；deep-reasoning 12–40s。额外结果与 AI 页面摘要按标准搜索计费。

offerings.name: Answer (/answer)
offerings.output_type: An LLM answer to a question, with citations

offerings.name: Contents (/contents)
offerings.pricing: $1 / 1k pages, per content type；AI page summaries $1 / 1k pages
offerings.output_type: Full page text, highlights, and summaries for known URLs
offerings.note: 一页带 text 与 highlights 计为两页；每个内容类型单独计费。

offerings.name: Monitors (/monitors)
offerings.pricing: $15 / 1k requests；超过 10 结果每个 $1 / 1k results；AI page summaries $1 / 1k pages
offerings.price_basis: PAYG 基础档（最多 10 结果）
offerings.output_type: Scheduled searches that surface new events on the web

offerings.name: Agent (Search tool calls)
offerings.pricing: Search tool calls $0.005 / search；Agent Compute Units $0.10 / ACU；固定 effort：minimal $0.012–xhigh $1.00 / run
offerings.price_basis: Agent metered usage（auto 默认 $5/run 上限）

offerings.note: auto 为默认 metered 模式；beta max 默认 $20/run 上限；含 Connect provider 额外费用。
